# max-kit: agent instructions

This folder is the control plane for max-kit. Before any non-trivial task read, in order:

1. `knowledge/synthesis/agent-boot.md`
2. `knowledge/harness/features-index.md`
3. `knowledge/harness/features/<ID>.yml` for the matched feature only

## Team rules

The single source is `knowledge/synthesis/team-rules.md`. Runtimes with hooks inject it at session start; otherwise read it before the first change.

## Branches

- Never push to: `main`. Push a task branch instead.

## Repos

No app repos configured yet; add them to `max-kit.config.json` › `repos`.

## Commands

| Command | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run check` | Quality gate: harness lint, index, log, links, boot budget, generated files |
| `npm run new:feature -- <ID> "<title>" <area>` | New draft feature (only with a real trigger) |
| `npm run new:run -- <ID> <slug>` | New evidence file; fill result, tier and commit |
| `npm run log -- <kind> "<title>" [note]` | Append to this month's log |
| `npm run index` | Regenerate the feature index |
| `npm run rollup` | Regenerate the log index and recent changes |
| `npm run sync` | Re-render AGENTS.md and runtime files after changing the config or rules |

## Done

No evidence means not done. Record verification in `knowledge/harness/runs/` or set the feature to `blocked` with the missing env, source, credential, data or decision.
